laws.invariant: When a turn completes, Station removes exactly the queued head before canonical dispatch; a definitive 4xx rejection removes that head instead of requeueing it into a refusal loop.

observation.selector: pops the head synchronously, then dispatches the canonical Agent target after the settle delay

faultInjection.selector: a definitive 4xx rejection drops the entry instead of requeueing and surfaces the failure

laws.invariant: A Flow run advances only when its gate evaluates matching evidence; completion is derived from that gate outcome rather than asserted by the caller.

observation.selector: passes the gate and advances when claim evidence matches

faultInjection.selector: routes back on failed evidence with attempt budget

laws.invariant: Only a known approval action can resolve actionable orchestration attention; an unknown action is rejected rather than failing open, and a real resolution marks the request actioned.

observation.selector: marks orchestration notifications actioned when the request resolves

faultInjection.selector: rejects unknown approval actions instead of failing open

laws.invariant: A granted Home renderer failure falls back to the built-in Home with the actual failure and a recovery action, never a blank root.

observation.selector: a renderer that throws on mount lands on the built-in Home with the actual failure text

faultInjection.selector: retry into a still-broken renderer lands back on the built-in, not a loop or a blank

laws.invariant: Release staging accepts only the complete required variant inventory, checksums, updater sidecars, and immutable container descriptor for one source identity.

observation.selector: assembles every required variant, sidecar, and immutable container

faultInjection.selector: fails when uploaded bytes differ from the assembled checksum

laws.invariant: Project and conversation switching remain directly reachable with readable context in the mobile dock header; opening a Project must not rebind the active conversation.

observation.selector: keeps project and conversation switching directly reachable with readable context

faultInjection.selector: opening a project preserves the active conversation binding
